upheld.title: Heading font size hardcoded instead of type token
upheld.detail: The 'More from {brand}' heading uses a raw 1.5rem font size while the design system defines --text-xl: 1.5rem and neighbouring rules in the same file use var(--text-*) tokens.
upheld.requirement: CAT-1 Outputs product page section; design system reuse (src/WebApp/wwwroot/css/app.css:337)

upheld.title: Unrelated BOM and lambda re-indent in CatalogApi.cs
upheld.detail: The diff adds a BOM at line 1 and un-indents the /catalogtypes and /catalogbrands lambdas, which have nothing to do with brand mates. The comment re-indent and new(){ reflow are cosmetic noise.
upheld.requirement: No unrelated changes mixed into the PR (style lens check 4)

upheld.title: Fully-qualified System.Text.Json.JsonException in the catch filter
upheld.detail: The exception type is spelled out inline instead of imported with a using, unlike the other exception types in the same filter.
upheld.requirement: Match the file's imports and naming style

upheld.title: Signed-in video does not visibly show the signed-in state
upheld.detail: TC-CAT-1-13 signs in and checks the result in code, but the recording never shows the login or anything that marks the session as signed in. The header icon in the frames is identical to the anonymous videos and the purchase button ('Add to shopping bag' vs 'Log in to purchase') is cut off at the to

Navigation is only inferred from the changed card s

dismissed.title: ICatalogService not extended with GetBrandMates
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic after the defender's rebuttal; no independent evidence shows the story requires extending ICatalogService.

dismissed.title: Hard-coded sizes in new CSS instead of design tokens
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic; the heading-size part duplicates UI-1-1 (kept), and the critic did not show that matching spacing or breakpoint tokens exist.

dismissed.title: CreateClient helper duplicated from WebhooksApiTests
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. The repeated code is a six-line test-only client setup (Bug16Tests.cs:10-16), and copying it is a style preference, not a guideline violation.

dismissed.title: Test class named after the ticket rather than the behavior
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. Naming tests after the ticket is a preference, and the Story/TestCase traits keep the link to BUG-16.

upheld.title: Long single-line Problem calls in the new helper
upheld.detail: The two TypedResults.Problem calls in ValidateBrandAndType put the message and statusCode on one line of about 150 characters, while the existing TypedResults.Problem usage in the same file wraps its arguments and uses the named detail: parameter.
upheld.requirement: Match the neighboring code in the file, e.g. the multi-line TypedResults.Problem(detail: ..., statusCode: ...) at CatalogApi.cs:256

upheld.title: Positional detail argument where neighbouring handlers name it
upheld.detail: TypedResults.Problem passes the message positionally (it binds to `detail`), while CancelOrderAsync and ShipOrderAsync use the named `detail:` argument. The behaviour is identical.
upheld.requirement: Match the nearest existing code: OrdersApi.cs:46 and :75 call TypedResults.Problem(detail: ..., statusCode: ...)

upheld.title: Redundant assertion in TC-BUG-15-01
upheld.detail: Assert.NotEqual(InternalServerError) directly after Assert.Equal(BadRequest) can never fail and is noise.

upheld.title: Speculative mapped-scope claim branch with inaccurate comment
upheld.detail: The comment says the JWT handler may map "scope" to http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/scope, but the default inbound claim map maps only "scp" to that type; "scope" (what Identity issues) arrives unmapped. The extra claim type in HasScope is guesswork and the comment misleads maintainers
upheld.requirement: Code style lens items 2 and 5 (no unexplained complexity; comments explain why accurately)

upheld.title: Test-plan index still says the mapped scope claim type is accepted
upheld.detail: The Out of scope section says the implementation also accepts the mapped claim type http://schemas.microsoft.com/identity/claims/scope. The STY-1-1 fix removed that; HasScope now reads only the 'scope' claim. The plan no longer describes the code.
upheld.requirement: Code style lens item 5 (comments and docs must describe the code accurately); follow-on to STY-1-1
